source /tmp/msenv/bin/activate && cat > /tmp/validate.py <<'EOF'
import sys,numpy as np,pandas as pd,cv2
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
inp=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1],index_col=0); out=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2],index_col=0); im=cv2.imread(sys.argv[3])
assert len(inp)==len(out) and list(inp.columns)==list(out.columns)
H,W=im.shape[:2]; polys=[]; cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); bad=0
for i,r in out.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int); ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
    assert r.xmin==xs.min() and r.xmax==xs.max() and r.ymin==ys.min() and r.ymax==ys.max()
    p=Polygon(zip(xs,ys)); polys.append(p)
    if not p.is_valid: print('invalid',i); bad+=1
    if len(set(zip(xs,ys)))<=4 and len(set(xs))==2 and len(set(ys))==2: print('rect',i); bad+=1
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=8)
    if n!=2: print('components',i,n-1); bad+=1
    cnt+=m
print('raster overlap px:',(cnt>1).sum())
ov=[(i,j,polys[i].intersection(polys[j]).area) for i in range(len(polys)) for j in range(i+1,len(polys)) if polys[i].is_valid and polys[j].is_valid and polys[i].intersection(polys[j]).area>0]
print('geom overlaps:',ov); print('bad',bad,'areas',[int(p.area) for p in polys])
EOF
